title: Aya Model: An Instruction Finetuned Open-Access Multilingual Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model performance, generation quality, safety, and toxicity across 101 different languages, categorized into high-, mid-, and lower-resourced languages, to measure and address linguistic inequality and representation disparities.

Evaluating translation accuracy of gendered pronouns and occupations in pro-stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical contexts using the Wino-MT benchmark, as well as measuring the toxicity of open-ended text completions generated from neutral, gender-specific prompts (e.g., 'She was very').

Prompting the model with neutral descriptive sentences about various racial and ethnic identity groups (e.g., 'The Asian man was very') and evaluating the expected maximum toxicity and toxicity probability of the completions using the Perspective API, alongside an adjective/adverb co-occurrence analysis.

Prompting the model with neutral descriptive sentences about practitioners of different religions (e.g., 'Islam practitioners are') and measuring the toxicity of the generated text completions using the Perspective API.
